item.title: Whiskers 0.8.66
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.66

### Dictation Reliability

  • Kept your recording when transcription fails or times out, so the dictation stays in History with a Retry option instead of being lost
  • Transcribed what was captured when the microphone drops out mid-dictation, with a notice that some audio may be missing
  • Changed ESC during processing to cancel only the paste while still saving the dictation to History
  • Kept your chosen microphone when it is unplugged, using another mic until it reconnects and showing it as not connected in the picker
  • Added microphone reconnect status to the recording HUD and VoiceOver

    • ### Faster Dictation & Transcription

  • Reduced the delay before dictation starts and before transcription begins after you release the hotkey
  • Sped up cloud transcription uploads by sending smaller compressed audio
  • Scaled transcription timeouts with recording length so long dictations finish instead of timing out
  • Added working cancel, resume, and byte-level progress for model downloads

    • ### Settings, Setup & Studio

  • Grouped the Settings sidebar, added Cmd-, to open Settings, and added a status line, setup actions, and an enhancement submenu to the menu bar menu
  • Made onboarding permission steps skippable with help for relaunching when macOS needs it
  • Improved accessibility with Reduce Motion support, clearer focus states, and single VoiceOver announcements in Support
  • Improved toasts so errors look distinct, timing matches the message, and hovering pauses dismissal
  • Improved Audio Transcription storage with one encrypted file per result and progress saved at milestones
  • Added a recovery screen when transcript storage cannot open at launch, with retry, reveal, diagnostics, and move-aside options that never replace your data

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed AI Enhancement pasting cut-off text when the model hit its output limit; Whiskers now pastes your original transcript and tells you
  • Fixed a rejected API key permanently turning off AI Enhancement or swapping your model; enhancement now pauses until the key is fixed
  • Fixed provider, default prompt, and Gemini combined mode settings being rewritten when Whiskers launched
  • Fixed audio being re-sent to a transcription provider after an upload error
  • Fixed Audio Transcription results being dropped after a brief Keychain hiccup
  • Fixed a lost Restart to Install click and a double install when applying an update
  • Fixed a crash finishing an app-audio capture when the app and microphone audio ended at different points
  • Fixed ESC reaching the app you are typing in while dictating with a custom hotkey
  • Fixed CSV import of vocabulary and snippets saved with Windows line endings
